summary: TradeOS Alpha Completion Pass — Production Library CRUD & Standards rename verified end-to-end. Backend: 11/11 pytest tests pass covering limit=500 pagination fix, default 50 fallback, limit>1000 rejection, include_inactive listing, POST /duplicate (-COPY suffix, name (Copy), is_company_standard=false), DELETE (soft-archive), POST /restore (round-trip), DELETE /permanent (removes unreferenced item + 404 on subsequent GET), DELETE /permanent blocked with 400 when item is used in an assembly, and auth-guard on all 3 new endpoints. Frontend: Production Library workspace loads with 434-item sidebar count under 'Production Standards' (no 'Company Standards' string on the page); search 'IMPORT-' narrows list to imported rows; filter panel exposes Active/Archived/All Status select; clicking an active item routes to /app/production-library/items/{id} with Edit + Duplicate + Archive + Remove Standard buttons visible; archived-item detail page shows Restore + Delete Permanently buttons (no Duplicate). The full CRUD lifecycle is wired correctly UI ↔ backend.

minor.issue: 'per_page' query param docstring says max 1000 but Query has le=1000 while default remains 50; if a caller passes both limit and per_page, limit silently wins with no warning.

Only copies a hard-coded subset of columns (production_per_day, crew_size, labour_hours, production_output, standard/premium/complex_rate, notes, description). Fields such as low_labour_rate, premium_labour_rate, material_rate, equipment_rate, division_id, trade_discipline, cost_code, tags, and attachments are NOT duplicated. Consider using original.copy() minus id/production_code/timestamps.
The endpoint does not create an initial revision row for the duplicate (unlike POST /items). Revision history for duplicates will show 'nothing' until first edit.

Checks assembly_items + estimate_line_items but NOT other likely references (projects, invoices, purchase orders). If the schema has additional FK tables, deletion could still fail at DB level or orphan rows. Consider centralising 'is_referenced' checks.
Does not verify the item is currently archived (is_active=false). Calling restore on an already-active item silently no-ops with success=true, which is confusing behaviour.

ui_bugs.issue: The header pill still reads 'Company Standard' (singular) and the toggle toasts show 'Production Standards' — mixed rename. If the pass renames the concept to 'Production Standards', the detail-page badge should read 'Production Standard' (or match the sidebar naming). Line ~470 of /app/frontend/src/pages/app/ProductionItemDetail.jsx.
Field label reads 'Company Standard: Yes/No' — should be 'Production Standard' to stay consistent with the rename. Line ~864.
Command palette Quick Action still labeled 'Create Company Standard' (line 391) instead of 'Create Production Standard'.
Filter panel toggle checkbox is labeled 'Production Standards Only' but the underlying field is is_company_standard. Label is consistent with rename — flagging for reference only.

integration_issues.issue: Right after Supabase SIGNED_IN, first GET /api/workspace/context and /api/command-center throw 'TypeError: Failed to fetch' in the console (visible on second load too). The request likely races the service-worker take-over. Doesn't block navigation to Production Library, but produces noisy console errors that could mask real failures.

verification_results.backend_limit_500_returns_full_page: PASS - meta.per_page=500, items length matches total (>=50)
verification_results.backend_include_inactive_returns_archive: PASS - archived item leaks out of active-only listing and appears when include_inactive=true
verification_results.backend_auth_guards_on_restore_duplicate: PASS - all 3 endpoints reject unauth requests
verification_results.frontend_no_Company_Standards_string_on_: PASS - substring not present in workspace listing view
verification_results.frontend_active_item_detail_has_Duplicat: PASS - Duplicate + Edit + Archive icon + Remove Standard buttons visible on active item detail
verification_results.frontend_archived_item_detail_has_Restor: PASS - Restore + Delete Permanently buttons visible, Duplicate hidden

action_items: Rename remaining 'Company Standard' strings on the detail page (header pill line ~470 & Status field line ~864 in ProductionItemDetail.jsx) and in the Command Palette Quick Action (line 391 in ProductionLibraryWorkspace.jsx) to 'Production Standard' to complete the rename pass.
Investigate the two post-login 'Failed to fetch' console errors on /api/workspace/context and /api/command-center. They fire on every fresh session and could mask real integration errors from ops.

Enhance /items/{id}/duplicate to copy ALL non-identity fields (low_labour_rate, premium_labour_rate, material_rate, equipment_rate, division_id, trade_discipline, cost_code, tags, service_category_ids) — current copy loses several columns silently.
Add an initial revision row on duplicate to keep revision history consistent with POST /items.
In /items/{id}/restore, guard against restoring an already-active item and return 400 or a clear no-op message instead of silent success.

Consider extending /items/{id}/permanent reference checks beyond assembly_items and estimate_line_items (projects, invoices, POs) or wrap the delete in a try/except that returns 400 with a clean 'still referenced' message when the DB constraint fires.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/production_library.py is still >2200 lines with import + CRUD + assemblies + attachments all in one router file. The 700-line guideline is exceeded 3x; split into production_library_items.py, production_library_assemblies.py, production_library_import.py, etc.
/items/{id}/duplicate cherry-picks fields; use a canonical serialiser (or SELECT * then strip id/production_code/created_at/updated_at) so future columns don't get silently dropped from copies.

/items/{id}/permanent only checks 2 tables. If new FKs are added (e.g., estimates_v2, po_line_items), stale checks will let a delete through and either 500 on FK violation or orphan referrers. Consider adding a Postgres function 'production_item_is_referenced(id)' or a DB trigger to keep this authoritative.

The frontend rename is incomplete: workspace lists and sidebar use 'Production Standards' but the item detail header, status field, and command-palette action still say 'Company Standard'. Users will see mixed language.
seed_data_creation: Each pytest run creates and cleans up a handful of TEST-CRUD-* items and one TEST-ASM-* assembly. Cleanup is best-effort: on assertion failure a few TEST-CRUD-* rows and one TEST-ASM-* assembly may remain in the Two Fungis Finishing org.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The Production Library workspace is at /app/production-library and currently shows 434 items for the Two Fungis Finishing org (367 active + 67 archived at test time). Archived filter works. Item detail routing is a full page at /app/production-library/items/{id} (NOT a slide-out) with different action sets for active vs archived items. Backend endpoint /items now accepts BOTH limit and per_page (limit wins). New endpoints live at POST /items/{id}/restore, POST /items/{id}/duplicate, DELETE /items/{id}/permanent. All three are auth-gated. Rename pass is 90% complete — three remaining 'Company Standard' strings live in ProductionItemDetail.jsx (~lines 470, 864) and ProductionLibraryWorkspace.jsx (~line 391).
rca of the issue: N/A — no functional bugs. Only cosmetic rename leftovers and non-blocking minor code-review observations.
